# Welcome to My Portfolio 👋

## 📊 Data Science & Analysis Projects

### [Data Science For Beginners](https://github.com/pawan1198/Data-Science-For-Beginners)
**Language:** Jupyter Notebook | **Type:** Educational Content

A comprehensive course with 10 weeks, 20 lessons of data science fundamentals. Perfect for beginners looking to get started with data science concepts and practical applications.

### [Learning Repository](https://github.com/pawan1198/learning-repo)
**Language:** Jupyter Notebook | **Type:** Educational Hub

A public notebook hub with detailed explanations of various statistical methods, machine learning algorithms, deep learning models, and image processing techniques.

### [COVID-19 Data Analysis](https://github.com/pawan1198/covid-19-data)
**Language:** Python | **Type:** Data Dataset & Analysis

Comprehensive data on COVID-19 cases, deaths, hospitalizations, and tests across all countries, updated daily. Sourced from Our World in Data.

### [Python for Data Analysis](https://github.com/pawan1198/pydata-book)
**Language:** Jupyter Notebook | **Type:** Educational Materials

Materials and IPython notebooks from "Python for Data Analysis" by Wes McKinney (O'Reilly Media).

### [Python for Beginners](https://github.com/pawan1198/Python-for-Beginners)
**Language:** Jupyter Notebook | **Type:** Learning Course

A beginner-friendly course to learn Python programming from scratch.
